name: jjbrandon8-verificar
description: Skill by jjbrandon8 that makes Claude cite or mark every fact.

plugins.name: verificar-antes-de-afirmar
plugins.description: Stops Claude from stating unverified facts, citing what it did not open, or misreporting how it searched: answers only from the sources you give it, or from original sources it opens and cites next to each fact. In Cowork and Claude Code, hooks keep an automatic tool log and review drafts against it. Spanish and English.
